questions.question: The demand for a normal good decreases with ________ in the consumer's income.
questions.solution:
Normal good, in economics, is a kind of good for which there is an increase in demand with increase in the income.

The demand for normal good decreases with the decrease in the consumer's income.

questions.question: Short run marginal cost curve cuts the short run average cost curve from _______ at the minimum point of short run average cost.
questions.solution:
Short-run marginal cost curve cuts the short run average cost curve from below at the minimum point of short run average cost.

The short-run marginal cost curve graphically represents the relation between the quantity of output produced and the marginal cost which is incurred by a company in the short-run production of a service or a good.

questions.question: "Naval, military and air force works" is listed in the __________ list given in the Seventh Schedule in the Constitution of India.
questions.solution:
The Union List is given in the Seventh Schedule of the Constitution and comprises of a list of 100 items including naval, military and air force works.

The legislative section of the Constitutions is divided into 3 lists, namely, Concurrent List, State List and Union List.

questions.question: There are total _________ parliamentary seats (Lok Sabha constituency) in Uttarakhand.
questions.solution:
There are total 5 parliamentary seats (Lok Sabha constituency) in Uttarakhand, which are Almora, Tehri Garhwal, Nainital, and Haridwar

Almora is reserved for candidates who belong to SC (Scheduled Caste), whereas, ST (Scheduled Tribes) candidates have no reservation.

questions.solution:

questions.question: Among plants, three different genera Solanum, Petunia and Datura are placed in which family?
questions.solution:
Among plants, three different genera Solanum, Petunia, and Datura are placed in Solanaceae family.

The Solanaceae family is considered to be an important family for flowering plants. It comprises of perennial and annual herbs, shrubs, vines, medicinal plants, agricultural crops, weed, spices and more.

questions.question: Convex and concave mirrors are examples of?
questions.solution:
• Convex and concave mirrors are examples of Spherical mirrors.
 
• A spherical mirror is a kind of mirror that has been cut out of a spherical surface.
 
• 
 
A concave mirror, or converging mirror, has a reflecting surface that is recessed inward (away from the incident light). Concave mirrors reflect light inward to one focal point. 

 
 
• They are used to focus light. Unlike convex mirrors, concave mirrors show different image types depending on the distance between the object and the mirror.
 
• These mirrors are called "converging mirrors" because they tend to collect light that falls on them, refocusing parallel incoming rays toward a focus. This is because the light is reflected at different angles at different spots on the mirror as the normal to the mirror surface differs at each spot.
 
• 
 
A convex mirror or diverging mirror is a curved mirror in which the reflective surface bulges towards the light source.

 
 
• 
 
Convex mirrors reflect light outwards, therefore they are not used to focus light. Such mirrors always form a virtual image, since the focal point (F) and the centre curvature (2F) are both imaginary points "inside" the mirror, that cannot be reached.

questions.question: In April 2017, Emma Morano, the world’s oldest woman has passed away at the age of 117. Which country was she from?
questions.solution:
Emma Morano was the world’s oldest person from Italy who died at an age of 117 in April 2017.

She was born on 29 November 1899 and was officially the last person born in the 1800s to be still alive.

In her lifespan, she has witnessed three centuries, 90 Italian Governments and 2 World Wars.

questions.question: Bangladesh does not share its border with which Indian state?
questions.solution:
Bangladesh shares its boundary with Indian states including Assam, Mizoram, Tripura, Meghalaya and, Bengal. It does not share its border with Jharkhand.

A 4,096 km long border is shared by India and Bangladesh and is known to be the fifth-longest land border of the world.

The Bangladeshi divisions which are situated along the border are Rajshahi, Khulna, Mymensingh, Rangpur, Chittagong, and Sylhet.
